$comment: Chapter 1 mission — Eye on the Storm. All numbers placeholder (4.10). Objectives are the observation windows.
title: Eye on the Storm
goal: Watch the cyclone from space and warn the coast in time.

outcomeTiers.text: Evacuation began a full day early.
Most coastal villages were ready in time.
Warnings came late. Kabir stays quiet.

briefing.speaker: alam
briefing.text: The meteorological department confirms it. A depression in the Bay. It will make landfall in twelve days, maybe less.

briefing.speaker: alam
briefing.text: You have a launch window in ten. I expect this agency to be on the news for the right reason.

briefing.speaker: sharmin
briefing.text: Six million taka. Not one taka more — and every taka has a mother, Director.

briefing.speaker: tanvir
briefing.text: We need cloud-top temperatures — that means thermal infrared. And pictures the public can understand. Visible camera if we can afford it.

briefing.speaker: kabir
briefing.text: The ride-share slot holds thirty kilograms. Design inside it, and we launch on time. That is the whole game.

briefing.speaker: kabir
briefing.text: Come to the design room when you are ready. We build her together.
